content: We are fixing duplicate charges in the checkout service. Keep the public API unchanged. The fix must be safe to retry and ship with a regression test.
The payment handler retries after a timeout without checking the idempotency key. I will move the lookup before the charge request and add a unique database constraint.

Here is the failing checkout screenshot.
data:image/png;base64,
The duplicate appears when two requests arrive together. The database constraint handles the race; the handler must also catch the unique-key conflict and return the existing payment.
